# Pull Request

## Description

Describe the proposed change and its purpose.

## Change Category

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research / methodology
- [ ] Testing / benchmarking
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Other

## Motivation

Why is this change necessary?

What problem does it solve?

## Implementation

Describe the implementation and any architectural
or methodological decisions.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where applicable.
- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation updated where necessary.
- [ ] No unintended changes to existing data or artifacts.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or private information included.

## Research and Data Provenance

For research-related changes:

- [ ] Sources and citations are included.
- [ ] External datasets are identified.
- [ ] Data licensing and usage restrictions are documented.
- [ ] Experimental assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Results are reproducible where reasonably possible.

## Intellectual Property and Licensing

- [ ] I have identified all third-party code and materials.
- [ ] I have disclosed applicable external licenses.
- [ ] I have the authority to submit this contribution.
- [ ] I have completed the applicable Contributor License Agreement,
      if required by the Maintainer.

## Maintainer Review

This pull request is a proposal only.

It does not establish acceptance, grant additional rights,
or authorize commercial use of Project materials.

Acceptance requires explicit approval by the Maintainer
and completion of applicable contribution agreements.
